# Halo Data Flow And Transfer Constraints

What can move between Corvane and the Halo hub today, what cannot, and why. Written for anyone in the group who needs to answer "can we just send them the file?"

## Summary

> [!warning]
> Physical samples move under the material transfer agreement; data do not. Until the board adopts the consortium transfer clause and Corvane signs the Halo data sharing agreement, Corvane may not upload pseudonymised patient-tier results linked to clinical data, nor receive the unblinding key or follow-up for the patient tier.

## What Can Move Now

- Truth-set aliquots, in and out, under the [[halo-material-transfer-agreement]].
- Code and container images, both ways, through the [[halo-wp4-analysis-code-repository]].
- Results on the contrived tier: cell-line material, no personal data, uploaded on 2026-08-04.
- Aggregate, small-cell-suppressed summaries, which the institute does not treat as personal data ([[is-fragment-level-cfdna-data-personal-data]]).

## What Cannot Move Yet

- Our patient-tier and donor-tier feature tables and calls to the hub. They are pseudonymised, hence personal data ([[pseudonymisation-vs-anonymisation]]).
- The patient-tier unblinding key and clinical follow-up to Corvane.
- Any St Aldric data, features or labels to the hub ([[st-aldric-mrd-cohort]]).

## Why

The current institute policy ([[corvane-data-access-policy-2023]]) allows bilateral transfers only; Halo's article 9 is multilateral ([[halo-consortium-agreement-summary]], [[halo-data-sharing-agreement-template]]). [[victor-lindahl]] and [[eva-novak]] confirmed this jointly in August. The fix is the consortium clause in [[data-access-policy-revision]]; the [[data-governance-board-2026-09-10]] supported the principle but did not adopt it. Next board 2026-11-12.

## Consequences

- WP4 can analyse the contrived tier but not the patient tier ([[halo-cross-site-benchmark]]).
- The external validation of the [[mrd-manuscript]], requested formally on 2026-08-04 ([[halo-validation-request-2026-08-04]]), waits on the same clause; fallback in [[should-halo-validation-run-federated-instead-of-transfer]].
- Steering committee condition: if still blocked by mid-2027, patient-tier analysis moves to Brightwater ([[halo-steering-committee-2026-09-17]]).
